# Does It ARM

> Does It ARM catalogs reported Apple Silicon compatibility for Mac apps, games, and Homebrew formulae, with reference pages for Mac models.

Software listings are under `/app/`, `/game/`, and `/formula/` on https://doesitarm.com. They carry a reported status when available and may include per-device evidence, related links, and benchmark videos. Mac model reference pages are under `/device/`. A missing listing means compatibility is unknown from this catalog. An `unreported` status means native support has yet to be reported.

## MCP server

- [Does It ARM MCP server](https://mcp.doesitarm.com/mcp): check Apple Silicon compatibility for Mac apps, games, and Homebrew formulae. Public, read-only Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account. Tools: search_apps, get_app, check_apps, list_categories, list_by_category, recent_updates, list_devices, check_inventory (up to 250 rows from a Mac app inventory export, matched by bundle ID first).
- [Install guide](https://github.com/ThatGuySam/doesitarm/blob/master/docs/mcp.md): Claude Code `claude mcp add --transport http doesitarm https://mcp.doesitarm.com/mcp`
